data.mac: MAC address (optional, enables power-on via Wake-on-LAN)
data.nickname: Name shown on the player as the paired device

pin.title: Enter the PIN
pin.description: The player is showing a PIN as on-screen text over HDMI — make sure a display is on and set to the player's input.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the player at that address.
error.invalid_pin: That PIN wasn't accepted — check the on-screen display and try again.
error.unexpected_response: The player didn't ask for a PIN the way this integration expects. It may need a different pairing mode.
